verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a self-hosted deployment that runs entirely on your own servers, cluster and LLM keys. That lets a user decide where run data and artifacts physically live, but the evidence shows no region or residency selection for the hosted cloud. The residential proxy country targeting is about browsing egress, not data storage, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection, documented data-residency guarantees or certifications, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your infrastructure: your servers, your browsers, your LLM API keys.
Run the Skyvern server on your own machine or cluster with pip, Docker Compose, or Kubernetes, using your own LLM keys or a local model.
